notes: equals is read as identity (a firm rule: whatever equals a number is that number), so e^iπ takes the sign of the value it equals. Only 1 and −1 are distinct. The sign query is the only dl query. q0 and q1 compare e^iπ with a stored value (i⁴ = 1; cos 0 = 1, firm bridges): equality of named values through the identity rule, no arithmetic. Relabelled dl (theory arithmetic dropped) on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

fol.notes: The value of e^(iπ) is the model's belief, a constant eipi; i⁴ and cos 0 are stored values (constants), and + is built-in (nothing changes addition). 'equals' is equality of values.

i4.says: i to the fourth power equals 1.
